name: Arena-Hard v2.0 preference scoring
description: Publisher-designated preview edition, scoped to its available preference-scoring method. The score label is not a new independently defined metric or a measured benchmark result. This is a source-only capability proposal. No evaluation, dataset admission, model/data permission, price quote or deployment gate is established. See research/T6-deployment-operations/evaluation.md.

Exact source blob aa9f2a2bcb28e7ce82496dc9bfca412a1ff2e386, SHA256 5da0fa30a807a150da37e97811c2bc248959015eedb884d9d471e894c8bf90c6, was read without importing or executing the package. Scores (%) is the literal displayed preference-score label. The method uses swapped comparisons and weights strong preference; missing judgments are dropped and reported. Optional style-control flags are separate from the default path. Its 0.05/0.95 bootstrap quantiles must not be described as a 95-percent interval. Judge, category, retained comparison count and bootstrap settings remain required result context.
